text:
marie: FYI I'm planning to bring up ap-east-2 GPU cluster tomorrow morning. quick security baseline run required before ops handoff — IAM roles, secrets pattern, KMS/HSM integration, network egress locks, policy scans, and cost tags.

raj: timeline?

marie: provisioning starts 09:00 UTC, basic smoke + policy scans by 11:00, ops handoff 15:00 UTC, SOC signoff target 17:00.

tasha: I can own IAM & KMS bindings. quick checklist I'm going to validate:
- control-plane role: redwood-cluster-controlplane-ap-east-2
- node role: redwood-node-gpu-ap-east-2
- kms access role: redwood-kms-access-ap-east-2
I'll push role ARNs to the terraform var file and open a 1-line PR for review.

raj: For secrets, use Vault transit + cloud-kms envelope pattern. Do NOT mount raw cloud creds into hosts. Example binding snippet I'll run locally:
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "allow_redwood" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:redwood-kms-access@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

marie: HSM note: ap-east-2 has a CloudHSM cluster available but we need key import and emergency owner configured. security@redwood.ai should be set as emergency PKI owner. Also enable key usage logs to stackdriver (90d).

tasha: Confirmed. Rotation window set to 30d for cluster keys. Emergency owner = security@redwood.ai. I'll enable audit export and set retention to 90d.

jon: Networking callouts: egress should be explicit allowlist only — artifact registry, S3 endpoints for model pulls, and KMS endpoints. Block all other outbound ranges (no 0.0.0.0/0 internet egress from nodes). Service perimeter rules to add:
- allow: artifact-repo.redwood.internal
- allow: s3.amazonaws.com (prefix list)
- allow: kms.googleapis.com
Also ensure no public SSH/RDP open to node pools.

ops-bot: qa-checklist triggered: iam-check, kms-bindings, secret-scans, vpc-egress, policy-scanner, cost-tags.

marie: Validation commands I'll run post-bootstrap (copy/paste):
```
# KMS IAM policy check
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/my-project/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/cluster-key 

# Vault transit encrypt smoke (ensures transit+kms works)
vault write transit/encrypt/cluster-key plaintext=$(echo -n test | base64)

# Secret scan (local helper)
./infra/tools/secret-scan --project ap-east-2 --threshold 0
```

raj: Cost controls: tag all resources with billing:team, env, project; create budget alert at 60% of committed spend and a hard cap via autoscaler limit on nodepool. Reserve a small committed capacity for baseline throughput to avoid burst costs.

tasha: After IAM + KMS green, I'll request SOC signoff. Failure mode: if policy-scanner finds non-compliant bindings, we disable nodepool creation and mark cluster as quarantined in prod-infra.

marie: Pinging owners in thread: @tasha @raj @jon — please ack. If no blockers, I'll kick tomorrow morning.

tasha: ACK
raj: ACK
jon: 👍

ops-bot: checklist status: IAM pending review, KMS bindings pending, secret-scan queued. Action items created: infra#4521 (IAM PR), infra#4522 (KMS audit).
